title: michaelwadman/pi-agent
summary: Docker Hub 公开 overview 将 michaelwadman/pi-agent 定义为 Pi coding agent 的容器化版本，并链接独立 GitHub 源码；latest manifest 的构建历史固定 PI_VERSION=0.84.4、安装 @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent、工作目录 /app、入口为 pi。
why_useful: 这是带有明确 upstream GitHub 源码链接和当前版本固定值的独立容器交付对象，可审查 Pi 版本更新、运行目录与容器入口之间的关系。
discovery_backend: official Docker Hub public repository search API exact pi-agent alias
readback_backend: official Docker Hub repository detail, overview, latest tag and manifest-history APIs (anonymous read-only)
limitations: 未拉取或运行镜像；latest tag 可变，manifest history 是构建元数据而非源码审计；GitHub 源码需另行只读核验，容器仍非安全背书。
readback_evidence: Official detail/overview endpoint HTTP 200, repository public; overview description says ‘A containerised version of the Pi coding agent’ and full_description links https://github.com/mwadman/pi-agent. Registered 2026-01-16; latest tag/detail read 2026-08-29, latest digest sha256:6c1d00c42718630b33d88ebb01abfe30d27cacbe28536c07d3eaa137fbe89e76. Official latest/images API HTTP 200 exposes amd64 layers including ARG PI_VERSION=0.84.4, npm install -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@${PI_VERSION}, WORKDIR /app and ENTRYPOINT ["pi"]. No login, pull, run, push or account interaction.
